patch.name: Hera 4
patch.notes: Juno-106 panel, four voices (the original has six; Hera 6 XL plays six in the browser). MIDI CC 64 is the hold pedal; Output sets volume. Poly 2 steals when all voices are busy. HPF 2/3 and chorus II settings are approximated by ear. Patch shift, tape, memory and the MIDI function switch are hardware or storage, not reproduced.

patch.name: Canvas
patch.notes: Music Easel patch field with four independent random outputs. Select PATCH to connect any control source to an input. FX fires the pulser. The Arpeggiator has a rate input in Hz. Missing: external audio/preamp/envelope detector and linear decay. Pulse/wave rows use numbers; sine is extra. Plates, trims, program cards and local/remote switching need hardware or storage. Low range starts at 0.22 Hz, not 0.17. Output split remains unverified.

patch.name: Io 4
patch.notes: Jupiter-4 architecture, four voices. UNISON ON is UNISON I; SHARE is UNISON II: one key uses four voices, two keys use two each, three or four use one each. Assignment still uses separate assign and unison rows. Other control gaps remain under the 1.5 fidelity audit.
